statement: A vented seal caused the loss of chamber pressure.
sources: Test record: Chamber pressure fell from 5.0 to 3.0 bar between 12:00 and 12:06. The seal vent was opened at 12:03. Pressure was already declining before the vent opened. No measurement isolated the contribution of the vent, supply regulator or other leakage paths.

statement: The service crew used an expired calibration certificate for instrument M.
sources: Certificate index: M certificate C17 valid through 30 June. Its replacement C18 becomes valid 1 July and remains valid through 31 December. Both certificates are stored in the archive.
Work ticket dated 12 July: instrument M, calibration certificate C18. Ticket attaches the signed C18 sheet. No use of C17 is recorded on this ticket.

statement: The two temperature readings disagree about the same operating state.
sources: Sensor T1: 20 degrees Celsius at 08:00, heater off.
Sensor T1: 60 degrees Celsius at 08:45, heater on for 40 minutes. Both measurements passed the reference check.

statement: At 09:15 no person was inside enclosure D.
sources: Security observation log: 09:15. Enclosure D fully visible from inspection walkway, no internal partitions or blind corners. Two named observers independently checked the entire interior at that time and saw no person. This log does not describe the interior at any earlier time.

statement: The shipping register lists crate K as weighing 80 kilograms.
sources: Shipping register: crate K, dispatch 10:00, recorded weight 80 kg.
Calibrated scale ticket for the same crate K at dispatch 10:00: 110 kg. Contents unchanged between register entry and weighing. Dispatch supervisor has not reconciled the weight discrepancy.

statement: Both release conditions were met before pump P restarted.
sources: Rule J requires BOTH an authorized maintenance release and a successful interlock function test before restarting pump P.
Maintenance release signed by the authorized supervisor at 13:00. Pump P restarted at 13:10. Interlock test record explicitly states: test not performed before restart; completed at 13:25.
